output.reason: [ev-2df1b23f32ac] says HTTP/3 can now be enabled on entry points without `experimental.http3`, that the option has been removed, and that setting it would prevent Traefik from starting. That means only environments that still set `experimental.http3` in their static configuration are exposed. The proposed `undecidable` operand covers every environment that uses HTTP/3, which is broader than that, because HTTP/3 enabled on entry points keeps working. I removed it and kept the two leaves that check whether the option is set.

correction.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 removes the static option experimental.http3 because HTTP/3 is no longer experimental. Setting it stops Traefik from starting. Only environments that still set experimental.http3 are exposed.
